criterion: Retain for sustained collective discussion: at least two repeatedly named canonical Gospels plus two plural mentions; a collective Gospel topic plus two plural mentions; or an explicit plural Gospels reference in the title or description. Repeated use of the plural word alone is insufficient. Posts that passed these signals were also removed when a semantic review found that the Gospels were incidental, limited to one Gospel, or secondary to another central subject.
